newsitem.title: GERMANY: Computer 2000's German sales, profit rose.
newsitem.headline: Computer 2000's German sales, profit rose.

text.p: German computer distributor Computer 2000 AG said on Thursday its German subsidiary saw sales increase 24 percent to 1.8 billion marks in 1996.
Profit at Computer 2000 Deutschland GmbH also showed a "clear rise" last year, the company said without providing precise figures.
German sales should push past two billion marks for the 1996-97 business year to September 30, said the firm, which is 75 percent owned by a unit of German utility VIAG AG.

In December, the company reported 1995-96 pretax profit of 10.1 million marks but a net loss of 15.6 million marks due to a 52 million mark loss at its Ameriquest Technologies Inc. in the United States.
Group sales last year grew 34 percent to 6.64 billion marks.
